key_insight: PhysTrace pinpoints when video observations conflict with history-conditioned physical expectations and explains the violations.
engineering_relevance: The framework can help engineers diagnose physical inconsistencies in video models used for prediction, planning, and action generation.
method: Generate history-conditioned physical expectations with a multimodal large language model.
Align expectations with observed video windows to localize and describe violations without task-specific training.
Analyze reconstructed videos across diffusion and flow model trajectories.
evidence_signal: On IntPhys2-Timing, which adds violation intervals to IntPhys2, PhysTrace achieves up to 70.7% Hit Rate across physical principles; on IntPhys2, it outperforms compared methods in overall possible–impossible discrimination accuracy.
watch_item: Reliance on MLLM-generated expectations warrants validation beyond the reported benchmarks before use in safety-critical planning.
paper_title: PhysTrace: Interpretable Temporal Evaluation of Physical Consistency in Video Generative Models
